name: s20-chat-repl-init
config:
[[permissions]]
tool = "apply_patch"
pattern = "*"
decision = "allow"
[[permissions]]
tool = "run_command"
pattern = "python -m pytest*"
decision = "allow"

runs.stdin:
/init
/model relay-model-2
/effort high
Fix the failing test, then add a `subtract(a, b)` function to src/calc.py with a docstring and a test.
/review
/btw In one sentence: did the review find anything that needs fixing?
/plan
/rename subtract-work
/export notes.md
/new
/resume subtract-work
In one sentence: what did this session change?
/status
/exit
